decision_rule: Both SI-SDR strictly increases and NMSE strictly decreases in fixed double-before window: directional support only. Neither improves: not supported. Mixed/nonidentifiable: inconclusive. With primary improvement, any decrease in identifiable far-only aggregate or individual fixed-block energy ratio, or any increase in peak, RMS or endpoint count, conservatively records a tradeoff (amplitude increase is not proof of quality loss); unavailable far comparisons without observed adverse directions remain inconclusive. No post-hoc numeric threshold.
